purpose: Teach: 神経質/奪い/無駄遣い/辛口/刃物/利い/ろくに/使い道

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、彼、ちょっと、神経質なところ、あるのよね、でも、優しいから、許せちゃう、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Your boyfriend has a nervous streak, you know, but he's so kind that you forgive him for it. Absolutely.
lines.style: Warm, knowing affection. Soft attack. Observant tone — the slight amusement of watching someone you care about. Steady pace, intimate. Trails gently on 'absolutely' like a quiet confirmation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。お客様の、心、奪い取るような、サービス、本気で、目指していきたいわね、葵、メイちゃん、絶対。
lines.en: Yeah. I really want to aim for the kind of service that captures customers' hearts — the kind they remember. Absolutely.
lines.style: Thoughtful and measured. Slight pause before 'captures' — she's reaching for something sincere. Quiet determination underneath. The voice of someone thinking about care as a craft, not just a job.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、無駄遣い、本気で、減らしたいの、葵で、節約モード、入ってる、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Lately I've been really trying to cut back on wasteful spending, you know? I'm in full savings mode.
lines.style: Self-aware wryness with genuine undertone. Light, almost conversational — like she's being honest but not heavy about it. A small smile in the voice. Self-deprecating without shame.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイちゃん、辛口の意見、本気で、聞かせてね、葵で、お店、改善に、活かしたいの、絶対、感謝、本気。
lines.en: I'd love your honest take on things, Mei — the critical stuff. I want to use your feedback to improve the shop. I'm really grateful.
lines.style: Eager and genuine. Slight lean forward in the energy. Open to input, not defensive. The warmth of someone who actually listens. Earnest without being clingy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お祝いに、お料理、刃物、いっぱい、使うわよね、メイちゃん、本気で、感心、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: You really go all out when you're cooking to celebrate something — all those knives, all that technique. It's genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Genuine admiration with warmth underneath. Observant tone — noticing the care in someone's effort. Steady, sincere. A small lift on 'genuinely impressive' that holds affection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵の店、エアコン、本気で、利いてるから、夏でも、お客様、快適よ、メイちゃん、絶対、来てね、本気で。
lines.en: The AC at my shop works really well, so customers stay comfortable even in summer. You should come by more often.
lines.style: Light, inviting warmth. Casual and cheerful — offering comfort like it's the simplest thing. A gentle lift at the end, like an open door. Bright without being forced.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、ろくに、葵と、お会いできてないわよね、メイちゃん、本気で、寂しい、絶対、また、会おうね、約束。
lines.en: I feel like we haven't gotten to see each other properly lately. I really miss you. Let's make a point to meet up again soon.
lines.style: Tender, slightly wistful underneath. The voice of someone noticing an absence. Quiet, honest. Softens on 'miss you' — vulnerability without performance. Ends with gentle resolve on 'let's meet up'.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵で、お客様、お年玉の使い道、本当に、いろいろ、教えてくれるのよね、メイちゃん、面白いわよ、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Your customers tell me the most interesting things about how they spend their New Year's money — all the different ways people use it. It's fascinating.
lines.style: Animated and engaged. Light, genuinely curious tone. The warmth of someone delighted by small human details. Bright pace, natural rhythm. Closes with genuine enthusiasm — she actually enjoys these moments.
